landing.title: The shopping list your whole family can share
landing.subtitle: Type your first item and create the list. Share the link: everyone can add and check items while you shop, with nothing to install.
landing.createError: Couldn't create the list. Please try again.
landing.step1Body: No sign-up. Type the first item and your list is ready to share.
landing.step2Body: Send the link to anyone. They can add and edit items without installing anything.
landing.step3Body: Check items off as you grab them. Everyone's phone syncs instantly.
landing.featuresTitle: Built for how people actually shop
landing.feature1Body: Create and share without an account. The link is the invitation.
landing.feature2Body: What one person checks off, the other sees instantly. Nothing gets bought twice.
landing.feature3Body: Stores have dead zones. The list keeps working and syncs when you're back online.
landing.feature4Body: Every item files itself into its section: produce, dairy, frozen…
landing.feature5Body: Say “two liters of milk and bread” and they appear as separate items, with quantities.
landing.feature6Body: Screen stays on, targets get big — check things off one-handed at the cart.
landing.faq1Q: Do I really not need an account?
landing.faq1A: Really. Type your first item, the list is created, and you can share it right away. No email, no password, nothing to install — it opens in the browser.
landing.faq2Q: How do I share the list with my family?
landing.faq2A: With a link. Tap share, send it however you like, and whoever opens it can view, add and check off items from their phone immediately.
landing.faq3Q: What if I lose signal inside the store?
landing.faq3A: Nothing breaks: the list works offline. Whatever you add or check off is saved on your phone and syncs automatically once you're back online.
landing.faq4A: Yes — creating, sharing and using lists is free. Optional premium features will come later, but the shared list stays free.
landing.faq5Q: Will I lose my lists if I sign up someday?
landing.faq5A: No. Your guest identity is a real account under the hood: when you sign up you keep the same lists, with nothing to copy over.

pricing.metaTitle: Pricing: free, and what comes later
pricing.metaDescription: Creating, sharing and using lists is free and will stay that way. Here's what's included and which paid features are planned.
pricing.title: Free, and meant to stay that way
pricing.subtitle: The shared list is the product, not the bait. No limit on lists, items, or the people you share them with.
pricing.freeNote: Forever, no card and no mandatory sign-up.
pricing.premiumNote: In the works. When it exists, it'll be announced before anything is charged.
pricing.whyBody1: A shopping list only works if the whole household has it, and charging for sharing breaks exactly that: one person not paying is enough to make the list useless for everyone.
pricing.whyBody2: So sharing is free and will stay free. Anything paid, if it arrives, will be what helps people already using the app daily and paying out of pocket — not what it takes to make it work.
pricing.included2: Share with anyone, no sign-up on their side
pricing.included4: Works offline and syncs when you're back
pricing.included5: Voice input, store mode and templates
